pull_request.body:
## Five-line summary

- Labeled all 28 observed token graph steps with their recorded work.
- Added hover/focus descriptions and clickable numbered markers.
- Added daily session breakdowns with input/output/combined subtotals and source links.
- Derived labels automatically from canonical turn owners, preserving unknown and undated coverage.
- Kept accounting unchanged and added attribution, accessibility and navigation regression checks.

The graph previously showed only seven selected merge milestones, leaving later usage jumps without work descriptions. Each observed UTC-day step now names its leading recorded session and indicates other sessions; selecting it opens every contribution for that day. Full labels remain visible below the graph. Merge markers retain their independent merge-date meaning.

Attribution uses the same unique turn ownership and exact closed-turn completion dates as the curve. A session spanning days contributes only the turns completed on that day. PR links describe recorded session scope; shared PR references do not split or multiply counters. Replayed inventories, unknown counters and undated turns retain their existing accounting behavior. No new client data or counters are collected.

Validation: 20 Python site tests and both JavaScript suites pass; browser checks cover graph focus labels, click/keyboard selection, hash reloads, mode changes and a 390 × 844 phone layout. Session/project/usage validation and the Pages preview build pass. Direct before/after comparison confirms all daily/cumulative counters, dates, undated counters and feature markers are identical: 309 disjoint observed turns, 1,306,633,934 combined tokens.

A separate read-only SoftEng assessment at 49613ee448850f28dd86f02eb508d20860879168 found no actionable correctness issues. It independently ran the 20 Python tests, JS controller checks, and parent/target accounting comparison; its report and source contract are retained in the session directory. Subsequent CSS-only phone-tooltip refinements were checked by the coordinator in the browser. Main-only Pages deployment is retained, so this becomes live after merge.

Infrastructure only; no detector or scientific-progress changes. ADR-004 remains DRAFT. Current task and review-agent token counters are unavailable and are not estimated.

coverage.token_accounting: References only. Never sum accounts across PRs or assign a shared turn by text length.
coverage.unknowns: Unrecorded names, models, tools, subagent identities and response links remain unknown; empty lists are not zero activity.
coverage.remote: Snapshot, not live synchronization; deleted/edited history and emoji reactions are not recovered.
coverage.branch_only: Pinned branch journal snapshots are references, not imported counters. Unretained or other-device inputs remain unknown.
